title: Carlos Eire's They Flew and the historical flying saints

tellings.quote: There's um a Yale professor, he's very well respected uh religious studies professor named uh Carlos Eire. He wrote a book called They Flew.

plain: Carlos Eire, a well-respected professor of religious studies at Yale, wrote a book called They Flew about Christian saints who were said to rise into the air, such as St. Joseph of Cupertino, Teresa of Avila and Francis of Assisi. Michels brings up the book himself as serious scholarship on these accounts. To him, it suggests that reports of people defying gravity have a long and documented history in Europe.
